transcript: I went to the first preview of Romeo and Juliet and Broadway last night starring Rachel Zegler and Kit Connor and I wanted to talk about this because they do interact people who are on the floor they also interact with people all over the entire theater so this show is at circle in the square which as name implies is done entirely in the round and the way they situated the show and I'm sure things will change cause this is the first preview but things are happening everywhere and I mean everywhere there are two entrances one here and one over there on the floor so actors are always entering there but they're also entering through the aisles they're running around where the standing room is and there's a catwalk up at the top that there running around there too it's chaos and it's so fun during the balcony scene I'm not gonna spoil how they do that because it's really good kit is literally running around and talking to people who are standing and you can buy standing room tickets to see Romeo and Juliet I believe they're all same day but I feel like those are gonna become like the seats and by seats I mean not seats cause you're literally standing also if you're in the aisles you get like some interaction again it's not like annoying interaction or you have to like participate it's just like little flirty glances or little asides but it really does add to this aesthetic of this Romeo and Juliet so well but I was seated in the back I was literally the second last row of the theater which honestly still great view there is no bad seat at circle but it was really fun where there be like something happening on stage and then I would look over to our aisle and you'd see like Rachel just hanging out there's also a lot of moments for the other actors are just watching from various points of the theater and I really liked finding them anyway if you want any kind of interaction sit in aisle. buy a standing room seat. go.
